en: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization
zh: 新增 Code Mode（实验性，需主动启用）：Claude 通过编写 JavaScript 来调用其工具；参见 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode 了解如何启用，或如何为组织关闭该功能
